name: SeaweedFS
description: SeaweedFS is a simple and highly scalable distributed file system. Compatible with S3, with an admin web interface.
composeYaml:
services:
  seaweedfs-master:
    image: 'chrislusf/seaweedfs:4.13'
    environment:
      - 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_USER}'
      - 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - 'seaweedfs-s3-data:/data'
      -
        type: bind
        source: ./base-config.json
        target: /base-config.json
        content: "{\n  \"identities\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"anonymous\",\n      \"actions\": [\n        \"Read\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"admin\",\n      \"credentials\": [\n        {\n          \"accessKey\": \"env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID\",\n          \"secretKey\": \"env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY\"\n        }\n      ],\n      \"actions\": [\n        \"Admin\",\n        \"Read\",\n        \"ReadAcp\",\n        \"List\",\n        \"Tagging\",\n        \"Write\",\n        \"WriteAcp\"\n      ]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n"
    entrypoint: "sh -c '\\\nsed \"s/env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/g\" /base-config.json > /base1-config.json; \\\nsed \"s/env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY/$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY/g\" /base1-config.json > /config.json; \\\nweed server -dir=/data -master.port=9333 -s3 -s3.port=8333 -s3.config=/config.json\\\n'\n"
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget --spider -q http://0.0.0.0:8333; [ $$? -le 8 ]'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
  seaweedfs-admin:
    image: 'chrislusf/seaweedfs:4.13'
    environment:
      - 'SEAWEED_USER_ADMIN=${ADMIN_USER}'
      - 'SEAWEED_PASSWORD_ADMIN=${ADMIN_PASSWORD}'
    command:
      - admin
      - '-master=seaweedfs-master:9333'
      - '-adminUser=${SEAWEED_USER_ADMIN}'
      - '-adminPassword=${SEAWEED_PASSWORD_ADMIN}'
      - '-port=23646'
      - '-dataDir=/data'
    volumes:
      - 'seaweedfs-admin-data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget --spider -q http://0.0.0.0:23646; [ $$? -le 8 ]'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    depends_on:
      seaweedfs-master:
        condition: service_healthy

meta.about: SeaweedFS is an open source distributed file system supporting WebDAV, S3 API, FUSE mount, HDFS, etc, optimized for lots of small files, and easy to add capacity.
